A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''individual''' was the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] male who represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The two were married by [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]] and living on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Between 34 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] and [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Antilles and his wife attended a [[Senator/Legends|senatorial]] gathering in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City's]] [[500 Republica/Legends|500 Republica]] building, at the [[Palpatine's apartment/Legends|apartment suite]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. While there, Antilles's wife was engaged in conversation by [[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]], the [[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Staff Aide]] of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
The wife of Bail Antilles appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]]..<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
